note: Generated by scripts/tests-first.mjs --update: do not edit. The replay of one commit.

failedFirst: a proposal written as a change set > with things, links and a SET together is passed by graph-spec’s check: a comma parts the items of a run, never a run from the SET
a decision recorded in a change set > is one line above the change, and one for the state after; every other byte, an author’s comment among them, is kept
a decision recorded in a change set > replaces its own line when the change is decided again, and takes it away when the decision is gone
a decision recorded in a change set > goes above a removal’s own line, and the state after is put with the other facts of the header
a decision recorded in a change set > in a change set written by something else adds no tag nobody decided: only the line of the decision
a decision recorded in a change set > is the whole change set written afresh only when the block no longer holds the proposal
accepting_is_an_edit: an accepted change is written as text, checked first, like any other edit > an undo that cannot be made, as the block has changed since, leaves the decision there to be undone

rejecting_recorded: rejecting a change leaves the graph unchanged and records the rejection in the change set > the record is one line added to the change set: the author’s own comments and every other byte of the note are kept
person_decides: the editor never applies a proposal without a person accepting it > the proposer is known by its name in any case, and no other name is taken for it

proposals_read_back: each proposed change is read back in plain English, as lines are in the text pane > each row also holds the exact text of the change: the GQL it writes, the SET line, or the removal
a person decides, a change at a time > Accept all, with a change that cannot be accepted among them, applies the rest and leaves that one waiting
a person decides, a change at a time > Accept for a group does the same: what can be accepted in it, and not what cannot
a person decides, a change at a time > a proposer that is not a person, and is called "you", does not stop the person at the keyboard
in reading view > a proposal with nothing to draw it over is listed with no buttons too, and a decision is not written
in reading view > a block drawn with no section information writes nothing: its proposal is shown, its buttons not offered
